Scaling rules

Source: vignettes/scaling-rules.Rmd
scaling-rules.Rmd

Product scaling fields select the quantity and the measurements used to calculate it. The returned log columns retain the bark basis, scaling diameter, and scaling length.

## Select example trees
trees <- example_trees %>%
  slice_head(n = 3)

volume_unit

Choices are scribner, international, doyle, cubic, green_ton, and cord. Board foot rules use inside bark diameters. Green ton scale includes wood and attached bark.

inside_bark

This field selects the bark basis for diameter limits. Cubic and cord scales use that same basis.

split_scale

This field selects shorter scaling sections for Scribner. It does not add physical cuts or affect other scale units.

round

Choices are default, down, nearest, and none. They control diameter preprocessing before the rule’s own rounding. none therefore does not disable rounding inside a source rule.

length_round

Nominal length rounds down to this scaling increment. Source board foot rules accept whole or even feet. Cubic, green ton, and cord scales use the nominal body and report scaling length for the measurement record.

## Define saw specifications
saw <- product(product = 'domestic_saw',  ## product name, unitless
               min_length = 31.5,  ## feet
               max_length = 31.5,  ## feet
               min_sed = 6,  ## inches
               volume_unit = 'scribner',  ## Scribner board feet
               inside_bark = TRUE,  ## logical, unitless
               split_scale = TRUE,  ## logical, unitless
               round = 'down',  ## rounding choice, unitless
               length_round = 2)  ## feet

## Cut and scale the trees
result <- merchandise(tree_id = trees$tree,
                      dbh = trees$dbh,
                      ht = trees$ht,
                      spcd = trees$spcd,
                      products = saw)
tree_id log length (feet) scaling_length (feet) sed (inches) scaling_diameter (inches) inside_bark scale (Scribner board feet)
1 1 31.5 30 6.327 6 TRUE 50
2 1 31.5 30 8.756 9 TRUE 100
3 1 31.5 30 10.451 10 TRUE 120
